purpose: Continuous-action validation before rebuilding the full 20-second video
camera: locked wide shot; no camera motion used to imply character motion

beats.shooter: bend knees and lower center of gravity; hands and ball move together; feet planted
beats.others: maintain box-out spacing and track shooter

beats.shooter: extend legs, lift ball, jump and release
beats.defender: react slightly late and jump to contest
beats.others: look up and adjust position without premature synchronized jumps

beats.shooter: hold follow-through; descend and land with bent knees
beats.defender: descend and land without foot sliding
beats.others: track the same ball and maintain physical spacing

beats.defender: recover balance and turn gaze toward basket
beats.others: small individual reactions; asynchronous spectator gestures

acceptance_criteria.review: normal speed and quarter speed; no abrupt body-pose or silhouette replacements
hands remain on the ball until release; planted shoes do not slide
stable head, jersey, limb length and number of limbs; no body-scale popping
defender reacts to the shooter; all players track one continuous ball
court lines, rim, roof and walls remain fixed
correct frame count, duration and decoding only after visual movement is accepted
